- The Participant appearing in the Video must be the account owner.
- The Video must be posted on their TikTok account during the Program Period;
- The Video must be compliant with the TikTok Platform's Community Guidelines;
- Privacy settings of the Video must be set to “public” so Video is publicly accessible;
- Each Participant may only win once under this Program.
3. Prizes

contents.desc: Yes I am pregnant and to celebrate this win in our lives, I cooked Carbonara using Del Monte’s Extra Creamy Carbonara sauce for our intimate celebration dahil every win in our lifetime deserves a Pasta Happy Time! May rewarding pasta dish ka rin bang maishashare? Share na to get a chance to join me and other pasta buddies KOLs at Del Monte Pasta Happy Hour event on September 12 in a secret location in Metro Manila! Just follow this mechanics: Submit a recipe video na fini-feature ang pasta-dish na ipagmamalaki mo!Include the ff on your video:- Tuwing kailan mo niluluto yung pasta dish mo as a reward?- What’s your creative name for this dish?- Pass the Pasta action- Post your video on TikTok and use the hashtag: #DelMontePastaHappyTimePromo and #naomipena or tag me as your pasta buddy! That easy! Contest will run until Sept 8, and pipili ako ng winner on Sept 9 na ma-i invite together with her chosen friend sa Del Monte Pasta Happy Hour Event! Madaming creamy carbonara pasta, madaming nakakatuwang activities katulad ng SPIT Manila, at madaming giveaways!#DelMontePastaHappyTime #DelMonte #DelMontePH #DelMonteSpaghettiSauceCarbonara #DelMonteCarbonara
